Subject: SIG follow-up — clarifying access ownership and provisioning

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for the initial SIG submission last week. Our SOC/SIG team reviewed the access control section and has a couple of follow-ups before we consider the control objective satisfied:

1) We need a clear owner mapping for privilege assignment — who in Redwood approves elevated roles vs. who performs the SCIM provisioning.
2) Examples of RBAC role definitions and the SCIM attribute mapping you use (which attributes map to role assignment).
3) Confirmation of enforced MFA and any exceptions, plus session timeout settings for the admin console.

Would you be able to provide a short CSV mapping (owner, action, evidence artifact) and any screenshots or endpoint docs? We can accept redacted screenshots.

We'd like to close this by next Friday (2028-05-19) if possible.

Thanks,
Emma

Subject: Re: SIG follow-up — clarifying access ownership and provisioning

Emma / Priyom — adding the technical details you requested. High-level pointers followed by attachments.

1) Ownership model (who approves vs who provisions)- Role approval: product security (Marissa Cole) + customer success for customer-scoped grants. We track approvals in our IAM ticketing queue (ticket IDs included in evidence CSV).- SCIM provisioning: performed by the provisioning service (automated) invoked by the control-plane; on-boarding requests are approved by a designated identity approver group (IDs in evidence).

2) SCIM mapping and RBAC- We attach redwood_scim_attribute_map.csv with the exact attribute -> claim mappings. Key fields: externalMailbox (email) -> userName, entitlement -> roleAssignment (boolean), groups -> groupIds.- Our RBAC model is coarse-grained role tiers: viewer, operator, admin, owner. The attached rbac-role-matrix.csv shows permissions per role and examples of least-privilege assignment rules (e.g., operators are denied access to billing routes).

3) MFA / session policies- MFA is enforced for all interactive admin console access via TOTP + FIDO2 for SSO sessions.- Admin console session timeout: 30 minutes of inactivity. API tokens for service accounts are long-lived but constrained by RBAC and require periodic rotation (90 days).

Evidence attachments: scim-endpoints.md (documented endpoints & sample requests), rbac-role-matrix.csv, sso-saml-flow.png (diagram), and a short audit-log extract that maps a sample provisioning event to the ticket and approver.

If you prefer, we can redact internal ticket numbers and only provide proof of the approval workflow. We can also produce a brief screencast of provisioning happening in our staging tenant.

Priyom — I added suggested evidence links in redwood_scim_attribute_map.csv and populated one sample row.

-M

--
Attachments: scim-endpoints.md; rbac-role-matrix.csv; sso-saml-flow.png

Thanks — that is exactly the level of detail we needed. Short clarifying Qs:

- For the 'entitlement -> roleAssignment' mapping, can you provide one concrete example where a SCIM PATCH results in an 'operator' role assignment?
- Can you include a redacted screenshot of the admin approver UI that shows the approval button + ticket ID?
- Please confirm whether any customers have requested MFA exceptions historically and how those were managed.

If you can attach the populated CSV and the redacted screenshot by EOD 2028-05-16 we'll triage this and close the SIG access control item. If not, the Thur 11am demo is fine.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Emma
